chunks: And in it it is narrated that the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said: Indeed, Allah, the Exalted and Glorified, did not grant Satan authority over the believers except over those who follow him.
And He granted him authority over the disbelievers.
ai.seo_question: Who does Satan have authority over according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq contextualizes this narration to affirm the doctrine of *al-Wilayah al-Tamam* (complete guardianship), illustrating that Satan's dominion is not absolute but contingent upon human free will (*ikhtiyar*). This distinction underscores the Shia theological principle that believers retain agency to either submit to Satan’s whispers or remain steadfast through divine grace, thereby limiting his authority to those who consciously align with him.
